Control_Description: Multifactor authentication is required for all company email accounts.
Evidence_Example_To_Request: Identity provider MFA policy export; sample account settings
Assessment_Notes: Do not mark effective until coverage is verified.

Control_Description: Employees receive phishing and credential-safety guidance.
Evidence_Example_To_Request: Training completion records; phishing reporting process
Assessment_Notes: The scenario only assumes basic reminders.

Control_Description: Endpoints receive security updates within defined timeframes.
Evidence_Example_To_Request: Endpoint inventory; patch compliance report; exception log
Assessment_Notes: Centralized monitoring and deadlines are recommended.

Control_Description: Critical data is backed up and restoration is tested periodically.
Evidence_Example_To_Request: Backup job reports; restore-test results; backup access list
Assessment_Notes: A successful backup job does not prove recoverability.

Control_Description: Access to customer/order data follows least privilege and is reviewed periodically.
Evidence_Example_To_Request: User-role export; quarterly access review sign-off
Assessment_Notes: Review should include joiners, movers, and leavers.

Control_Description: Critical vendors are reviewed for security and continuity considerations.
Evidence_Example_To_Request: Vendor inventory; security questionnaire; contract/SLA review
Assessment_Notes: Prioritize vendors supporting sales and payment workflows.
